messages:
Tara (ML Eng): Brought up kafs-v1-q5 on staging for multilingual smoke. Seeing bracket flips in mixed-script detok (JP/KO/HAN) and punctuation mirror in Arabic on longer outputs. Anyone seen this with q5?
Noah (NLP): Short repro?
Tara (ML Eng): run kafs-v1-onboard-2026-03-23. Repro JP: 日本[カタ] -> detok: 日本]カタ[. AR long sample flips parentheses orientation after ~130 tokens.
Rashid (Serving): Quick check: disable prefix caching and re-run minimal sample. If it disappears it's likely detok+prefix position metadata.
Tara (ML Eng): Disabled prefix cache on one canary node: JP flip gone on that node. Arabic mirror still reproducible.
quant-bot: automated compare: q5 vs fp16 BLEU deltas: ja->en -0.5, ko->en -0.2, ar->en -1.6. Artifact: https://ci/internal/evals/kafs-v1/2026-03-23
Noah (NLP): I'll add a pair-flip detector (paired-punct) to eval job and run short/long contexts with prefix cache toggled.
Rashid (Serving): If Arabic persists, might be double bidi pass in detok. Short-term: fallback to fp16 detok for rtl locales until we patch.
Tara (ML Eng): Action items: 1) Noah add detector + run (Tara), 2) Rashid prototype fp16-detok fallback for ar/he (canary). Will post results in ~90m.
